prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: a hard day-old baguette, a bottle of milk, a block of cheese — one second still. Then motion: the bread sliced thick, dunked into seasoned milk that soaks visibly into the crumb, slices laid into a buttered dish, cheese grated over in a blizzard. Money shot: out of the oven — the top golden and blistered, a spatula lifting one slice with cheese pulling in long strands, custardy interior steaming, backlit. Final beat: a bite cut, the soft center collapsing. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the milk soak, then the cheese pull. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o pão de ontem que vira torrada de forno cremosa — quase uma rabanada salgada de queijo. **Sábado que vem: [A] carne moída, cenoura e batata-doce ou [B] atum, ovo e batata? Comenta A ou B 👇**
